findings: Actual driver evaluates all and training arrays with the same training-fitted nonlinear and covariance state, then subtracts photometric Q and relative log determinants only.
Dense Schur-complement conditional residual/covariance agrees, including train-held covariance, duplicate epochs, f=0/.2/.95 and calibration scale/floor.
Native held-out sigma determinant and N log(2pi) restore absolute negative twice Gaussian predictive density; native constants cancel for fixed-data candidate comparisons.
All HST stays in training. Reprofiled angular nuisance contributions are deliberately excluded from the photometric score difference.
Original midnight-based score is preserved as an exact conditional diagnostic, but its 154 short crossfold pairs invalidate the stated whole-night interpretation.
Version2.1 local-noon partition has2464 held-out measurements, no crossfold adjacent gap below0.25day, and identical IDs using independently sourced LCO longitude.
conditions_for_outcome_interpretation: Training fit must converge and retain competing baseline modes; inspect failed/lower-objective states and use declared continuation if needed.
Plug-in conditional Q chi-square probabilities omit estimated mean/calibration uncertainty and are approximate; matching simulated/refitted controls are required for interpretation.
Training initialization from full-data modes is declared numerical mode discovery; final held-out score uses only the training objective fitted state.
Prediction success cannot override residual/structure/profile/systematics failures, and no numerical mass point is automatically a black-hole classification.
Never replace frozen partition IDs or model candidates based on predictive outcomes.
